scope: Ten audited base-paper genitive/locative plural comparative forms vyših.
choice: Restore the missing comparative š: vyših to vyšših at all ten exact sites.
motivation: Every site means higher and belongs to the comparative vysši/edition-surface vyšš- paradigm. The source form wrongly collapses the comparative stem before the regular soft-stem plural ending.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining vyših would preserve a malformed comparative stem.
Normalizing to vysših was rejected because the edition consistently realizes this established comparative family as vyšš-.
A global *ih rewrite was rejected because soft pronouns, cardinals, participles and other paradigms require separate adjudication.

evidence.official_grammar: Official adjectives.md lines 14 and 16 govern regular agreement and soft-stem -ih; line 67 directly derives vysoky to vysši, proving the additional comparative š.
evidence.edition_controls: Seven existing canonical vyšših tokens establish the selected house surface.
evidence.semantic_audit: All ten mapped contexts mean higher and modify genitive or locative plural forms/formulae/derivatives/complex numbers; positive and adverbial cases are zero.
evidence.protected_domains: No target occurs in a comment, foreign-language/title argument or TeX control name. Valid kojih and někojih and separately unresolved njihovi/tretji/cardinal families are outside the map.

validation.coverage: Exactly ten whole-token vyših sites, all in the base papers, match the frozen locator inventory.
validation.postcondition: Whole-token vyših is zero and vyšših rises from 7 to 17.
validation.structure: Line count, raw brace counts, unescaped dollar count, ordered TeX-control stream and math-delimiter stream are invariant; the other three source files are byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: The frozen successor reproduced before atomic application and matched the applied output hashes.
